entries.title: Proverbs 23:1
segments: When you sit down to eat with a ruler, look carefully at what [is] before you;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:2
segments: and put a knife to your throat, if you [are] a man given to appetite.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:3
segments: Do not desire his delicacies, for they [are] deceitful food.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:4
segments: Do not labor to be rich; cease from your own understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:5
segments: Will your eyes fly on it? And [it] is gone! For surely it makes wings for itself; it flies [into] the heavens like an eagle.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:6
segments: Do not eat the bread of [him who has] an evil eye, nor desire his dainty foods;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:7
segments: for as he thinks in his heart, so [is] he; Eat and drink, he says to you, but his heart [is] not with you.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:8
segments: Your bit [which] you have eaten, you shall vomit up, and spoil your pleasant words.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:9
segments: Do not speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:10
segments: Do not remove the old landmarks, and do not enter into the fields of the fatherless;

entries.title: Proverbs 23:11
segments: for their Redeemer [is] mighty; He shall plead their cause with you.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:12
segments: Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to the words of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:13
segments: Do not withhold correction from a boy, for [if] you beat him with the rod, he will not die.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:14
segments: You shall beat him with the rod, and shall deliver his soul from hell.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:15
segments: My son, if your heart is wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:16
segments: Yea, my heart shall rejoice when your lips speak right things.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:17
segments: Do not let your heart envy sinners; but [be] in the fear of the LORD all the day long.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:18
segments: For surely there is a hereafter, and your hope shall not be cut off.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:19
segments: My son, hear and be wise, and guide your heart in the way.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:20
segments: Do not be among those who drink much wine, among gluttons for flesh for themselves,

entries.title: Proverbs 23:21
segments: for the drunkard and the glutton lose all, and sleepiness shall clothe [a man] with rags.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:22
segments: Listen to your father who sired you, and do not despise your mother when she is old.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:23
segments: Buy the truth, and sell [it] not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:24
segments: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice; and he who fathers a wise [child] shall have joy from him.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:25
segments: Your father and your mother shall be glad, and she who bore you shall rejoice.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:26
segments: My son, give Me your heart, and let your eyes watch My ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:27
segments: For a harlot [is] a deep ditch, and a strange woman [is] a narrow pit.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:28
segments: She also lies in wait as [for] prey, and increases the treacherous among men.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:29
segments: Who [has] woe? Who has sorrow? Who [has] fighting? Who [has] babbling? Who has wounds without cause? Who has redness of eyes?

entries.title: Proverbs 23:30
segments: Those who stay long at the wine, those who go to seek mixed wine.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:31
segments: Do not look upon the wine when it is red, [when] it gives its color in the cup, [when] it goes down smoothly

entries.title: Proverbs 23:32
segments: At the last it bites like an asp and stings like an adder.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:33
segments: Your eyes shall look upon strange women and your heart shall speak perverse things.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:34
segments: Yes, you shall be as one who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as one who lies upon the top of a mast,

entries.title: Proverbs 23:35
segments: [saying], They struck me; I was not sick; they beat me, [but] I did not know it. When I awaken, I will add [more]. I will seek it again.
